metrics.profile_summary: Senior strategic Brand Manager and P&L owner with extensive experience in portfolio management and growth leadership. Expert in driving revenue and margin uplift through data-driven planning and cross-functional team leadership across diverse industries.

experience.description: Manages end-to-end portfolio strategy and P&L, delivering 6% YoY revenue growth and 3.2% gross margin improvement through pricing optimization and 360° integrated campaigns.

experience.role: Assistant Manager – Market Research & Data Analytics
experience.description: Led market segmentation and NPI concept testing, converting consumer insights into targeting strategies that delivered 1-2% market share growth.
Optimized profitability and budgeting, generating PKR 400 million in cost savings and developing automated commercial dashboards via Qlik.
Contributed to the launch of Engro NP Plus (PKR 3 billion revenue in Year 1) and led SAP S/4 HANA commercial implementation.
Executed brand communication strategies and managed social media platforms to increase engagement and brand awareness.
Supported brand planning, innovation launches, and the development of digital marketing content.

strengths: Extensive experience in brand and campaign management
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to marketing
Proven track record of managing agencies and digital communications
weaknesses: Significantly overqualified for a Specialist role
No explicit mention of Canva or Meta Business Suite
evaluation.summary: The candidate possesses all required skills and far exceeds the minimum experience and education requirements. However, their profile is that of a senior strategic leader (Brand/Portfolio Manager) rather than an execution-focused Marketing Specialist.
